scope: The exterior of Waseda University’s Ōkuma Auditorium in its 2024 configuration, including the mapped hall and rear curve, three Tudor entrance arches, and the attached 38-meter northwest clock tower. The neighboring high-rise, statue, separate grounds and interiors are outside scope.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The university gives the 125-shaku (approximately 38-meter) clock tower and 2007 restoration.
The national register describes the three-story 1,225.95-square-meter auditorium and seven-story attached northwest clock tower on its west front.
